test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 13 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Seven friends Harshita, Eshika, Jaismine, Kapil, Reshma, Mohit and Nilesh are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. Harshita is sitting second to the right of Mohit and third to the left of Kapil. Eshika and Jaismine are the immediate neighbours of Kapil. Nilesh is sitting second to the right of Eshika.

Who is sitting to the immediate right of Harshita?
solution:
**Seven friends - **Harshita, Eshika, Jaismine, Kapil, Reshma, Mohit and Nilesh are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre.

1. Harshita is sitting second to the right of Mohit and third to the left of Kapil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/422b18d10f877ddf55b98865df84b3eeed6abe01f0520871ac841ee6d3f8d24f.png] 

2. Eshika and Jaismine are the immediate neighbours of Kapil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fad961468265204bc2237c1cf2f70d5179d18ff417633f65230cd1bf2bb19579.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf01a7fa3cb59c936efc89dd76cfe3201aeafd972ff20f011f7ac962d7528369.png] 

3. Nilesh is sitting second to the right of Eshika.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/405de6a9d3cf477bd70bd029c56fc5be2e9171dbfadea2361d72db3edf422852.png] 

The above condition cannot be satisfied in Case I, so it is eliminated.

Only Reshma is left and she will occupy the vacant position.

The final arrangement will be as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a108c9b571d65ff2ddc93a87005415c696d10884f21b6bedc3e846b3e7ad24b.png] 

Clearly, Reshma is sitting to the immediate right of Harshita.

Hence, ‘**Reshma**’ is the correct answer.
